pages.title: Perfused Tissue
pages.text: A sheet of living cells kept alive by a network of fine channels carrying nutrient and oxygen to every one, as blood does. It dies if carried about too long. Made on the Perfusion Rig.
Made in $(item)Perfusion Rig$().$(br2)$(thing)Unlocked by$(): Circulation.$(br2)$(thing)Used in$(): Grown Organ, Matrix Fibre, Miniaturiser, Stem Cell Culture, Symbiont Lining.
